mapper.select: SELECT id, query_text AS queryText, context_pack_json AS contextPackJson, 1 - (query_embedding <=> #{queryVector}::vector) AS similarity FROM serving_query_cache WHERE domain = #{domain} AND release_id = #{releaseId} AND expires_at > now() AND query_embedding IS NOT NULL ORDER BY query_embedding <=> #{queryVector}::vector LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO serving_query_cache (id, domain, release_id, query_text, query_embedding, context_pack_json, hit_count, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{domain}, #{releaseId}, #{queryText}, #{queryVector}::vector, #{contextPackJson}::jsonb, 1, now(), now() + INTERVAL '24 hours') ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
